## Q11: API-layer handler function(s) that call `Store.CreateMemo`

1. **`APIV1Service.CreateMemo`** in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, line 115:

   memo, err := s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)

   This is the primary RPC handler (defined at line 70).

2. **`ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo`** in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, line 306-307 -- this is a thin wrapper that delegates to `s.APIV1Service.CreateMemo(ctx, req.Msg)`, which in turn calls `Store.CreateMemo`.
